name: insite-assurance-monorepo
description: InSite Assurance — Field Evidence & Disbursement Reconciliation Platform

scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=@insite/server run build
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=@insite/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm --workspace=@insite/server run typecheck && npm --workspace=@insite/web run typecheck && npm --workspace=@insite/mobile run typecheck
